Approximate leave-one-out cross-validation for AME / LAME fits

Source: R/loo_methods.R
loo.ame.Rd

S3 method for loo that uses the per-iteration pointwise log-likelihood stored on the fit object (fit$log_lik) when the model was fit with save_log_lik = TRUE. Returns the standard loo object with Pareto-k diagnostics.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ame'
loo(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lame'
loo(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'ame_als'
loo(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted ame or lame object that has $log_lik.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to loo::loo.matrix (e.g. cores, r_eff).

Value

A loo object.

Details

Observed likelihood factors. LOO and WAIC require a current fit$log_lik_contract verifying observed-data conditional likelihood factors. Latent augmented scores, approximate rank/cap diagnostics and legacy fits without this contract are rejected. Directed cell marginals do not factorize under nonzero or estimated residual dyad correlation; joint dyad factors would be needed. Symmetric fits store each unordered dyad once. Correct marginal predictive scores remain useful and readable through read_log_lik() even when LOO or WAIC is unavailable.

Chunked log-lik portability. When a lame fit is run with save_log_lik = "chunked", the on-disk chunk files default to tempdir(), which is cleared at the end of the R session. If you intend to saveRDS() the fit and reload it in a fresh session, supply an explicit persistent log_lik_path (e.g. "./loglik_chunks") so the chunks survive the round trip.

Examples

# \donttest{
data(YX_nrm)
# chains = 1 keeps the example short; the default runs two chains and compares them
fit <- ame(YX_nrm$Y, Xdyad = YX_nrm$X, R = 0, dcor = FALSE,
           nscan = 400, burn = 50, odens = 1,
           save_log_lik = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, chains = 1)
if (requireNamespace("loo", quietly = TRUE)) {
  loo_res <- loo::loo(fit)
  print(loo_res)
}
#> 
#> Computed from 400 by 9900 log-likelihood matrix.
#> 
#>          Estimate    SE
#> elpd_loo -14414.6  70.6
#> p_loo       189.4   2.7
#> looic     28829.1 141.2
#> ------
#> MCSE of elpd_loo is 0.7.
#> MCSE and ESS estimates assume independent draws (r_eff=1).
#> 
#> All Pareto k estimates are good (k < 0.62).
#> See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.
# }
